title: OpenAI Slashes Prices by 80% for GPT-5.6 Luna, Cost-Effectiveness Surpasses DeepSeek V4 Pro
excerpt: OpenAI officially announced the new pricing plan for the GPT-5.6 series. This price adjustment only applies to the mid-range and lightweight models Terra and Lu
content_html:
OpenAI officially announced the new pricing plan for the GPT-5.6 series. This price adjustment only applies to the mid-range and lightweight models Terra and Luna, while the flagship GPT-5.6 Sol maintains its original pricing. Luna, which is designed for batch lightweight inference scenarios, has seen the largest price reduction in its history, with both input and output costs dropping by 80%.

Before the price adjustment, Luna cost $1 per million input tokens and $6 for output. After the adjustment, input costs have dropped to just $0.2 (about 1.4 RMB), and output costs are now $1.2 (about 8.1 RMB). The balanced version of the same series, Terra, has also been reduced by 20%, with input at $2 and output at $12. The Sol model, which focuses on complex code and multimodal deep thinking, remains at its original price, forming a clear tiered strategy: "low-cost Luna captures the market, high-end Sol ensures profit."

Comprehensive cost-performance superiority, compensating for cost shortcomings

OpenAI simultaneously released an evaluation chart from the third-party organization Artificial Analysis, comparing mainstream lightweight commercial models based on two dimensions: cost per task and comprehensive model scores. Data shows that under the new pricing, Luna's overall cost-performance ratio fully surpasses DeepSeek V4 Pro when completing tasks of the same standard. It scores higher and costs less in scenarios such as general text creation, multi-turn dialogue, and tool calls.

Previously, the biggest shortcoming of overseas models compared to domestic high-cost-performance products was cost. This price cut directly addresses that issue. Industry analysts believe the fundamental driving force behind the significant price drop comes from the continuous low-price pressure from domestic large models—DeepSeek V4 Pro achieves extremely low repeated input costs through caching mechanisms, maintaining low prices during off-peak hours. Combined with multiple domestic companies continuously launching affordable API services, this has been continuously diverting overseas small developers. When the low-price advantage of domestic models is no longer a moat, the next battle in the large model industry may have just begun.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 正式公布了 GPT-5.6 系列的新定价方案。 此次价格调整仅适用于中端和轻量级车型Terra和Luna，而旗舰级GPT-5.6 Sol则维持原价。 专为批量轻量级推理场景而设计的Luna，迎来了史上最大降价，输入和输出成本均下降了80%。

在价格调整之前，Luna 每百万输入代币的成本为 1 美元，输出代币的成本为 6 美元。 调整后，投入成本降至仅0.2美元（约1.4元人民币），产出成本现在为1.2美元（约8.1元人民币）。 同系列的平衡版本 Terra 也降低了 20%，输入为 2 美元，输出为 12 美元。 专注于复杂代码和多模态深度思考的Sol模型，保持原价，形成清晰的分层策略：“低成本Luna占领市场，高端Sol确保利润”。

综合性价比优势，弥补成本短板

OpenAI同时发布了第三方机构Artificial Analysis的评测图，从单任务成本和模型综合得分两个维度对主流轻量级商业模型进行了对比。 数据显示，在新定价下，Luna在完成同标准任务时，整体性价比全面超越DeepSeek V4 Pro。 在一般文本创建、多轮对话、工具调用等场景下得分更高、成本更低。

此前，海外车型相比国内高性价比产品最大的短板就是成本。 这次降价直接解决了这个问题。 业内分析人士认为，价格大幅下跌背后的根本驱动力来自于国产大机型持续的低价压力——DeepSeek V4 Pro通过缓存机制实现极低的重复投入成本，在非高峰时段保持低价。 加之国内多家公司不断推出价格实惠的API服务，不断分流海外小开发者。 当国产车型的低价优势不再是护城河时，大模型行业的下一场战斗或许才刚刚开始。
